attempts.prompt:

Child's name: Ram (always allowed; spell it EXACTLY like this. In Nepali you may attach case endings: Ramले, Ramको, Ramलाई, Ramमा, Ramसँग)
Theme: eating momo dumplings with family, in a mountain village in Nepal
Focus units to practise often: ay, d, f

Every word in the title and story MUST come from the word bank (case-insensitive).
Use ONLY words from the word bank. No other words at all, not even small ones.

Rules:
- 3 to 4 short sentences, at most 6 words each. Simple, warm, coherent. Repetition is good.
- Every word at most 5 sounds long (the child's name is exempt). Prefer short words.
- A short title using the same constraints.
- Everyday Nepali child life: family, village, animals, food, school.
- No violence, fear, danger, sadness or adult themes.
- "scene": one English sentence describing a picture for the story (animals and objects, no detailed faces).
